svg.title: Pay a payment link — request lifecycle
svg.desc: A four-phase diagram showing the public GraphQL request boundary, the idempotent Postgres transaction, the response paths, and the pending asynchronous outbox delivery chain.
svg.text: Pay a payment link — request lifecycle
Implemented payLink path → atomic Postgres commit → replay-safe response; planned delivery is marked explicitly
payLink is public and currently has no rate limiter
Parse or DTO failure → Apollo client error; PaymentsService is never called and no transaction opens.

g.aria-label: Load and check the payment link
Create payment and atomic side effects
g.text: Assign mock provider id; no real money movement
Get/create merchant balance; load platform clearing
Write DEBIT clearing + CREDIT merchant entries
Ledger is append-only; balance holds by service construction
Store payment.succeeded outbox row; no relay yet
Nothing persists — not even the claim

svg.text: Implemented now: synchronous mock settlement and transactional outbox storage. Planned delivery appears below.

g.aria-label: Format GraphQL errors without leaking internals
g.text: Parse / DTO failure → Apollo client error
HTTP status + duration histogram recorded on finish
correlation ID ties the request logs together

svg.text: Planned continuation after a successful commit

g.text: durable and ready for a future relay

svg.text: Also pending: provider-webhook ingestion. It is an alternative future ingress and is not part of today’s payLink request path.
payLink · implemented request path + explicitly marked target continuation
